scope: Live profile form, authenticated API readback, independent SQLite readback and fresh-page persistence; no provider inference
pause_note: Journal pause metadata and the Supervisor's start-paused dispatch are separate controls.
limitations: Built-in profiles are preserved; the added profile is user-defined and unverified, not a live model-compatibility result.
Live profile persistence across an API restart was not exercised; restart persistence was tested in isolation and live committed storage was read independently.
No new database credentials were extracted or used; Neo4j API authentication awaits approval.
Control authentication lasts 30 minutes; another browser needs its own pairing/recovery procedure.
No cold-start browser test, simulation, model inference or graph publication was performed.
